svg.title: Open caisson foundation — Opinn sökkulbrunnur
svg.desc: A large hollow cylindrical caisson has thick walls, an open centre and two pointed cutting edges at its lower rim.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-open-caisson-foundation","label_en":"Open caisson foundation","label_is":"Opinn sökkulbrunnur","section":"04","category_en":"Excavation, foundations and ground engineering","category_is":"Uppgröftur, undirstöður og jarðtækni","batch":2,"tags":["foundation","caisson"],"description":"A large hollow cylindrical caisson has thick walls, an open centre and two pointed cutting edges at its lower rim.","design_note":"The hollow well and visibly open bottom distinguish a sinking caisson from a solid bored pile.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
